name: ai-text-loading

frames.best_why: Both loaders read at full brightness: the large "Thinking..." word and the timed status line; later frames blur or dim.

tagline: Words cycle with a soft wave of dimming letters while an AI thinks.
summary: A large loading word from a rotating set of thinking phrases, with a faint brightness wave running through its letters. An optional second style adds a changing status phrase and a seconds counter.
appearance: Large bold white words centred on a dark stage, with a smaller grey status phrase and a seconds number below. The letters are evenly spaced, and some frames catch them mid-fade so parts of a word look blurred and dim.
behaviour: Every interval the phrase swaps and its letters rise and unblur in a stagger. A soft opacity wave sweeps across the letters continuously, and with the counter on the seconds tick up beside the status phrase.
demo_content: Thinking, Processing, Analyzing, Computing and Almost, plus status lines such as Reading 14 files.
use_when: An AI action runs for a while and a plain spinner feels too anonymous for the wait.
avoid_when: The endless wave never settles and the bold oversized words overpower a small chat bubble.
customise: Props set the phrase list, swap interval, an accessible label and whether a seconds counter shows; the type size and wave timing live in the source.
weight_why: A handful of animated letter spans; the wave runs in CSS off the main thread.

a11y.note: Live status is announced and reduced-motion stops the wave, but the rotating phrase is hidden so only the fixed label is read.

issues: Words are split into individual letter spans, so the text is awkward to select or translate.
polish_why: Soft, well-timed thinking indicator; bold type may overpower tight spaces.
